		OK_TO_IVR as string,

		PTC_EXPIRATION as string,

		PTC_SCOPE as string,
		PTC_SOURCE as string,
		PTE as string,
		PTE_DATE as string,
		PTE_EXPIRATION as string,
		PTE_MODIFIED_BY as string,
		PTE_SCOPE as string,
		PTE_SOURCE as string,
		PLAN_NAME as string,
		PRIMARY_ADDRESS_CHANGE as string,
		PRIMARY_PRODUCT_OF_INTEREST as string,
		SAME as string,
		SUBSCRIBER_CONTACT_ID as string,
		SUBSCRIBER_MRN as string,
		TEFRA as string,
		BC2_CONTACT_ID as string,
		EMPLOYER_GROUP as string,
		MEDICAID_NUMBER as string,
		ISMEDICARE as string,
		OK_TO_MAIL as string,
		GROUP_SIZE as string,
		SECONDARY_MRN as string,
		MEMBERSHIP_STATUS as string,
		LIS as string,
		DUALS as string,
		HOME_COUNTY as string,
		MAILING_COUNTY as string,
		PTT as string,
		PTT_SCOPE as string,
		PTT_SOURCE as string,
		PTT_DATE as string,
		DIGITAL_ID as string,
		SPECIAL_COHORT as string,
		MRN_PREFIX as string,
		FILE_NAME as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: false,
	validateSchema: true,
	ignoreNoFilesFound: false,
	wildcardPaths:['raw/ib_kpma_contact_update*']) ~> inbound
DerivedColumn select(mapColumn(
		ADFId__c,
		Id = CONTACT_ID,
		Customer_Id__c = CUSTOMER_ID,
		FirstName = FIRST_NAME,
		MiddleName = MIDDLE_NAME,
		LastName = LAST_NAME,
		Medicare_First_Name__c = MEDICARE_FIRST_NAME,
		MedicareMiddleInitial__c = MEDICARE_MIDDLE_NAME,
		Medicare_Last_Name__c = MEDICARE_LAST_NAME,
		OtherStreet,
		OtherCity = HOME_CITY,
		OtherStateCode = HOME_STATE,
		OTHERCOUNTRYCODE,
		OtherPostalCode,
		MailingStreet,
		MailingCity = MAIL_CITY,
		MailingStateCode = MAIL_STATE,
		MAILINGCOUNTRYCODE,
		MailingPostalCode,
		HomePhone = PRI_PHONE,
		OtherPhone = ALT_PHONE,
		Email = EMAIL_ID,
		Birthdate = BIRTHDT,
		Gender__c = GENDER,
		Preferred_Spoken_Language__c = PREF_LANG,
		Group_Type__c = GROUP_TYPE,
		Group_Name__c = GROUP_NAME,
		Group_Number__c = PID,
		Subgroup_Number__c = EU,
		Medical_Record_Number__c = MRN,
		KPMember__c = KP_MBR,
		Prospect_Type__c = PROSPECT_TYPE,
		MBI__c = HICN,
		Deceased__c = DECEASED,
		Do_Not_Solicit__c = DO_NOT_SOLICIT,
		Do_Not_Mail__c = DO_NOT_MAIL,
		HasOptedOutOfEmail = DO_NOT_EMAIL,
		DoNotCall = DO_NOT_CALL,
		MobilePhone = CELL_PHONE,
		Phone = WORK_PHONE,
		interest_level__c = INTEREST_LEVEL,
		Interest_Level_Reason__c = INTEREST_LEVEL_QUALIFIER,
		retirement_date__c = RETIREMENT_DATE,
		Has_dual_coverage__c = DUAL_COVERAGE,
		Test_Contact__c = TEST_FLAG,
		Subgroup_Name__c = SUBGROUP_NAME,
		Promo_Id__c = PROMO_ID,
		Conversion_Type__c = CONVERSION_TYPE,
		GroupMedicarePlan__c = GROUPMEDICAREPLAN,
		Medicare_Permission_to_Call__c = PTC,
		Medicare_Permission_to_Call_Scope__c = PTC_SCOPE,
		Medicare_Permission_to_Call_Source__c = PTC_SOURCE,
		Medicare_Permission_to_Call_Expire_Date__c = PTC_EXPIRATION,
		Medicare_Permission_to_Email__c = PTE,
		Medicare_Permission_to_Email_Scope__c = PTE_SCOPE,
		Medicare_Permission_to_Email_Source__c = PTE_SOURCE,
		Medicare_Permission_to_Email_Expiration__c = PTE_EXPIRATION,
		Medicare_Permission_to_IVR__c = OK_TO_IVR,
		Subscriber_MRN__c = SUBSCRIBER_MRN,
		Subscriber_Contact_Id__c = SUBSCRIBER_CONTACT_ID,
		Bad_Email__c = BADEMAIL,
		Best_Time_to_Reach__c = BESTTIME,
		CMS_ENROLL_SUBMIT_DATE__c = CMS_ENROLL_SUBMIT_DATE,
		CMS_FILE_DATE__c = CMS_FILE_DATE,
		employerGroupNum__c = EMPLOYER_GROUP_NUM,
		Employer_Group_Type__c = EMPLOYER_GROUP_TYPE,
		MEDNET_APP_ID__c = MEDNET_APP_ID,
		MEDNET_APP_SUBMIT_DATE__c = MEDNET_APP_SUBMIT_DATE,
		Dependent_Contact_Id__c = DEPENDENT_CONTACT_ID,
		Dependent_MRN__c = DEPENDENT_MRN,
		Dependent_spouse__c = DEPENDENT_SPOUSE,
		Deps_has_dual_coverage__c = DEPS_HAS_DUAL_COVERAGE,
		Deps_is_member__c = DEPS_IS_MEMBER,
		Deps_other_coverage__c = DEPS_OTHER_COVERAGE,
		Kpre_id__c = KPRE_ID,
		mailing_address_change__c = MAILING_ADDRESS_CHANGE,
		Medical_Service_Area__c = MEDICALSERVICEAREA,
		MedNameSame__c = MEDNAMESAME,
		Member__c = MEMBER,
		Member_Type__c = MEMBERTYPE,
		name_change__c = NAME_CHANGE,
		notInterested__c = NOTINTERESTED,
		Ok_to_Call_Lis__c = OK_TO_CALL_LIS,
		Pbp__c = PBP,
		Plan_Id__c = PLAN_ID,
		Plan_Name__c = PLAN_NAME,
		primary_address_change__c = PRIMARY_ADDRESS_CHANGE,
		Primary_product_of_interest__c = PRIMARY_PRODUCT_OF_INTEREST,
		Same__c = SAME,
		TEFRA__c = TEFRA,
		BC2_CONTACT_ID__c = BC2_CONTACT_ID,
		Effective_Date__c = EFF_DT,
		Medicare_Permission_to_Mail__c = OK_TO_MAIL,
		Membership_Status__c = MEMBERSHIP_STATUS,
		LIS__C = LIS,
		Duals__C = DUALS,
		Is_Medicare__c = ISMEDICARE,
		Notes__c = NOTES,
		Coverage_Address_County__c = HOME_COUNTY,
		County__c = MAILING_COUNTY,
		Medicare_Permission_to_Text_New__c = PTT,
		Medicare_Permission_to_Text_Scope__c = PTT_SCOPE,
		Medicare_Permission_to_Text_Source__c = PTT_SOURCE,
		Medicare_Permission_to_Text_Expire_Date__c = PTT_DATE,
		Digital_ID__c = DIGITAL_ID,
		Special_Cohort__c = SPECIAL_COHORT,
		Medical_Record_Number_Prefix__c = MRN_PREFIX
	),
	skipDuplicateMapInputs: false,
	skipDuplicateMapOutputs: false) ~> Select2
ReplaceCaretString derive(OtherStreet = concatWS(' ',HOME_ADDR1,HOME_ADDR2),
		OtherPostalCode = concatWS('-',toString(HOME_ZIP),toString(HOME_ZIP4)),
		MailingStreet = concatWS(' ',MAIL_ADDR1,MAIL_ADDR2),
		MailingPostalCode = concatWS('-',toString(MAIL_ZIP),toString(MAIL_ZIP4)),
		PTC_DATE = coalesce(toString(toDate(PTC_DATE, 'MM/dd/yyyy')), PTC_DATE),
		PTC_EXPIRATION = iif(upper(PTC) == 'NO', toString(null()), coalesce(toString(toDate(PTC_EXPIRATION, 'MM/dd/yyyy')), PTC_EXPIRATION)),
		PTE_DATE = coalesce(toString(toDate(PTE_DATE, 'MM/dd/yyyy')),PTE_DATE),
		PTE_EXPIRATION = iif(upper(PTE) == 'NO', toString(null()),coalesce(toString(toDate(PTE_EXPIRATION, 'MM/dd/yyyy')),PTE_EXPIRATION)),
		DO_NOT_MAIL = iif(upper(DO_NOT_MAIL)=='Y','yes', iif(upper(DO_NOT_MAIL)=='N','no', DO_NOT_MAIL)),
		DO_NOT_SOLICIT = case(isNull(DO_NOT_SOLICIT),'false',coalesce(toString(toBoolean(DO_NOT_SOLICIT)),DO_NOT_SOLICIT)),
		GENDER = case(upper(GENDER) == 'F', 'Female', upper(GENDER) == 'M', 'Male',  upper(GENDER) == 'U', 'Undeclared', GENDER),
		OK_TO_EMAIL_FOR_SEMINARS = case(isNull(OK_TO_EMAIL_FOR_SEMINARS),'false',coalesce(toString(toBoolean(OK_TO_EMAIL_FOR_SEMINARS)),OK_TO_EMAIL_FOR_SEMINARS)),
		PREF_LANG = case(lower(PREF_LANG) == 'eng', 'English', lower(PREF_LANG) == 'spa', 'Spanish', PREF_LANG),
		BADEMAIL = case(isNull(BADEMAIL),'false',coalesce(toString(toBoolean(BADEMAIL)),BADEMAIL)),
		NOTINTERESTED = case(isNull(NOTINTERESTED),'false',coalesce(toString(toBoolean(NOTINTERESTED)),NOTINTERESTED)),
		RETIREMENT_DATE = iif(RETIREMENT_DATE == '^', '1800-01-01', coalesce(toString(toDate(RETIREMENT_DATE, 'yyyyMMdd')),RETIREMENT_DATE)),
		MAILINGCOUNTRYCODE = case(isNull(MAIL_STATE) == false(), 'US'),
		OTHERCOUNTRYCODE = case(isNull(HOME_STATE) == false(), 'US'),
		CMS_ENROLL_SUBMIT_DATE = coalesce(toString(toDate(CMS_ENROLL_SUBMIT_DATE, 'MM/dd/yyyy')), CMS_ENROLL_SUBMIT_DATE),
		CMS_FILE_DATE = coalesce(toString(toDate(CMS_FILE_DATE, 'MM/dd/yyyy')), CMS_FILE_DATE),
		MEDNET_APP_SUBMIT_DATE = coalesce(toString(toTimestamp(MEDNET_APP_SUBMIT_DATE, 'yyyyMMdd HH:mm')), MEDNET_APP_SUBMIT_DATE),
		DECEASED = coalesce(toString(toBoolean(DECEASED)),DECEASED),
		BIRTHDT = coalesce(toString(toDate(BIRTHDT, 'yyyyMMdd')), BIRTHDT),
		DO_NOT_EMAIL = iif(upper(DO_NOT_EMAIL)=='Y','yes', iif(upper(DO_NOT_EMAIL)=='N','no', DO_NOT_EMAIL)),
		DO_NOT_CALL = coalesce(toString(toBoolean(DO_NOT_CALL)),DO_NOT_CALL),
		DUPE_FLAG = coalesce(toString(toBoolean(DUPE_FLAG)),DUPE_FLAG),
		EFF_DT = coalesce(toString(toDate(EFF_DT, 'yyyyMMdd')), EFF_DT)) ~> DerivedColumn
inbound derive(ADFId__c = uuid()) ~> addADFId
addADFId derive(REJECT_REASON = case(isNull(CONTACT_ID), 'ADF:REQUIRED FIELD MISSING: CONTACT_ID', 

(INTEREST_LEVEL == 'Continuing to Work') && ((INTEREST_LEVEL_QUALIFIER != 'No Retirement Date') || isNull(INTEREST_LEVEL_QUALIFIER)) && (isNull(RETIREMENT_DATE) || (RETIREMENT_DATE == '^')), 'ADF:REQUIRED FIELD MISSING: RETIREMENT DATE',
 (not(startsWith(CONTACT_ID, '003')) && not(startsWith(CONTACT_ID, '00Q'))), 'ADF:INVALID CONTACT_ID', 
 (isNull(PTT)==false()&&(lower(PTT)!='yes'&&lower(PTT)!='no')||lower(PTT)=='yes'&&(isNull(PTT_SCOPE)||isNull(PTT_SOURCE))),'ADF: PTT ERROR')) ~> addRejectReason
addRejectReason split(isNull(REJECT_REASON) == false(),
	disjoint: false) ~> ConditionalSplit2@(toReject, toUpsert)
ConditionalSplit2@toReject select(mapColumn(
		ADFId__c,
		REJECT_REASON
	),
	skipDuplicateMapInputs: true,
	skipDuplicateMapOutputs: true) ~> Select5
Select2 split(startsWith(Id, '003'),
	startsWith(Id, '00Q'),
	disjoint: false) ~> ConditionalSplit3@(splitContact, splitLead)
ConditionalSplit3@splitLead select(mapColumn(
		ADFId__c,
		Id,
		Customer_Id__c,
		FirstName,
		MiddleName,
		LastName,
		Medicare_First_Name__c,
		MEDICARE_MIDDLE_NAME__c = MedicareMiddleInitial__c,
		Medicare_Last_Name__c,
		OtherStreet__c = OtherStreet,
		OtherCity__c = OtherCity,
		OtherState__c = OtherStateCode,
		OtherPostalCode__c = OtherPostalCode,
		Street = MailingStreet,
		City = MailingCity,
		StateCode = MailingStateCode,
		COUNTRYCODE = MAILINGCOUNTRYCODE,
		PostalCode = MailingPostalCode,
		Home_Phone__c = HomePhone,
		Other_Phone__c = OtherPhone,
		Email,
		Birthdate__c = Birthdate,
		Gender__c,
		Preferred_Spoken_Language__c,
		Group_Type__c,
		Group_Name__c,
		Group_Number__c,
		Subgroup_Number__c,
		KPMember__c,
		Member_Type__c,
		MBI__c,
		Deceased__c,
		Do_Not_Solicit__c,
		Do_Not_Mail__c,
		HasOptedOutOfEmail,
		DoNotCall,
		MobilePhone,
		Phone,
		interest_level__c,
		retirement_date__c,
		Has_dual_coverage__c,
		test_flag__c = Test_Contact__c,
		Subgroup_Name__c,
		Promo_Id__c,
		Conversion_Type__c,
		GroupMedicarePlan__c,
		Medicare_Permission_to_Call__c,
		Medicare_Permission_to_Call_Scope__c,
		Medicare_Permission_to_Call_Source__c,
		Medicare_Permission_to_Call_Expire_Date__c,
		Medicare_Permission_to_Email__c,
		Medicare_Permission_to_Email_Scope__c,
		Medicare_Permission_to_Email_Source__c,
		Medicare_Permission_to_Email_Expiration__c,
		Medicare_Permission_to_IVR__c,
		Subscriber_MRN__c,
		Subscriber_Contact_Id__c,
		Bad_Email__c,
		Best_Time__c = Best_Time_to_Reach__c,
		CMS_ENROLL_SUBMIT_DATE__c,
		CMS_FILE_DATE__c,
		employerGroupNum__c,
		Employer_Group_Type__c,
		MEDNET_APP_ID__c,
		MEDNET_APP_SUBMIT_DATE__c,
		Dependent_Contact_Id__c,
		Dependent_MRN__c,
		Dependent_spouse__c,
		Deps_has_dual_coverage__c,
		Deps_is_member__c,
		Deps_other_coverage__c,
		Kpre_id__c,
		mailing_address_change__c,
		MedicalServiceArea__c = Medical_Service_Area__c,
		MedNameSame__c,
		Member__c,
		name_change__c,
		notInterested__c,
		Ok_to_Call_Lis__c,
		Pbp__c,
		Plan_Id__c,
		Plan_Name__c,
		primary_address_change__c,
		Primary_product_of_interest__c,
		Same__c,
		TEFRA__c,
		BC2_CONTACT_ID__c,
		Effective_Date__c,
		Medicare_Permission_to_Call__c = Medicare_Permission_to_Mail__c
	),
	skipDuplicateMapInputs: true,
	skipDuplicateMapOutputs: true) ~> Select6
ConditionalSplit3@splitContact select(mapColumn(
		ADFId__c,
		Id,
		Notes__c
	),
	skipDuplicateMapInputs: true,
	skipDuplicateMapOutputs: true) ~> Select7
ConditionalSplit3@splitLead select(mapColumn(
		ADFId__c,
		Id,
		Notes__c
	),
	skipDuplicateMapInputs: true,
	skipDuplicateMapOutputs: true) ~> Select8
ConditionalSplit3@splitContact filter(retirement_date__c=='1900-01-01'||Birthdate=='1900-01-01'||Effective_Date__c=='1900-01-01'||CMS_ENROLL_SUBMIT_DATE__c=='1900-01-01'||CMS_FILE_DATE__c=='1900-01-01'||MEDNET_APP_SUBMIT_DATE__c=='1900-01-01'||Medicare_Permission_to_Email_Expiration__c=='1900-01-01'||Medicare_Permission_to_Call_Expire_Date__c=='1900-01-01') ~> Filter1
Filter1 select(mapColumn(
		Id,
		kp_Retirement_Date__c = retirement_date__c,
		kp_Birthdate = Birthdate,
		kp_Effective_Date__c = Effective_Date__c,
		kp_CMS_ENROLL_SUBMIT_DATE__c = CMS_ENROLL_SUBMIT_DATE__c,
		kp_CMS_FILE_DATE__c = CMS_FILE_DATE__c,
		kp_MEDNET_APP_SUBMIT_DATE__c = MEDNET_APP_SUBMIT_DATE__c,
		kp_Medicare_Permission_to_Call_Expire_Date__c = Medicare_Permission_to_Call_Expire_Date__c,
		kp_Medicare_Permission_to_Email_Expiration__c = Medicare_Permission_to_Email_Expiration__c
	),
	skipDuplicateMapInputs: true,
	skipDuplicateMapOutputs: true) ~> Select9
ConditionalSplit3@splitLead filter(retirement_date__c=='1900-01-01'||Birthdate=='1900-01-01'||Effective_Date__c=='1900-01-01'||CMS_ENROLL_SUBMIT_DATE__c=='1900-01-01'||CMS_FILE_DATE__c=='1900-01-01'||MEDNET_APP_SUBMIT_DATE__c=='1900-01-01'||Medicare_Permission_to_Email_Expiration__c=='1900-01-01'||Medicare_Permission_to_Call_Expire_Date__c=='1900-01-01') ~> Filter2
Filter2 select(mapColumn(
		Id,
		kp_RETIREMENT_DATE__c = retirement_date__c,
		kp_Birthdate__c = Birthdate,
		kp_Effective_Date__c = Effective_Date__c,
		kp_CMS_ENROLL_SUBMIT_DATE__c = CMS_ENROLL_SUBMIT_DATE__c,
		kp_CMS_FILE_DATE__c = CMS_FILE_DATE__c,
		kp_MEDNET_APP_SUBMIT_DATE__c = MEDNET_APP_SUBMIT_DATE__c,
		kp_Medicare_Permission_to_Call_Expire_Date__c = Medicare_Permission_to_Call_Expire_Date__c,
		kp_Medicare_Permission_to_Email_Expiration__c = Medicare_Permission_to_Email_Expiration__c
	),
	skipDuplicateMapInputs: true,
	skipDuplicateMapOutputs: true) ~> Select10
Select7 filter(isNull(Notes__c)==false()) ~> Filter3
Select8 filter(isNull(Notes__c) == false()) ~> Filter4
ConditionalSplit2@toUpsert select(mapColumn(
		ADFId__c,
		Id = PIPE_OPP_UID,
		PURL__c = PURL,
		Effective_Date__c = EFF_DT,
		PBP__c = PBP,
		FS_Agent_ID__c = FS_AGENT_ID,
		TS_Agent_Id__c = TS_AGENT_ID
	),
	skipDuplicateMapInputs: true,
	skipDuplicateMapOutputs: true) ~> Select11
Select11 filter(isNull(PURL__c) == false()) ~> Filter5
ConditionalSplit2@toUpsert derive(each(match(in(['PURL','NOTES','RETIREMENT_DATE','BIRTHDT','EFF_DT','CMS_ENROLL_SUBMIT_DATE','CMS_FILE_DATE','MEDNET_APP_SUBMIT_DATE','PTE_EXPIRATION','PTC_EXPIRATION'],name)==false()), $$ = iif($$ == '^', ' ', $$)),
		each(match(in(['RETIREMENT_DATE','BIRTHDT','EFF_DT','CMS_ENROLL_SUBMIT_DATE','CMS_FILE_DATE','MEDNET_APP_SUBMIT_DATE','PTE_EXPIRATION','PTC_EXPIRATION'],name)==true()), $$ = iif($$ == '^', '1900-01-01', $$))) ~> ReplaceCaretString
ConditionalSplit3@splitContact sink(allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	partitionFileNames:['ib_kpma_contact_update_Contact.csv'],
	mapColumn(
		each(match(name!='Notes__c'))
	),
	partitionBy('hash', 1)) ~> upsertContact
addADFId sink(allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	partitionFileNames:['ib_kpma_contact_update_raw.csv'],
	skipDuplicateMapInputs: true,
	skipDuplicateMapOutputs: true,
	partitionBy('hash', 1)) ~> curatedInbound
Select5 sink(allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	partitionFileNames:['ib_kpma_contact_update_source_reject.csv'],
	skipDuplicateMapInputs: true,
	skipDuplicateMapOutputs: true,
	partitionBy('hash', 1)) ~> RejectFile
Select6 sink(allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	partitionFileNames:['ib_kpma_contact_update_Lead.csv'],
	skipDuplicateMapInputs: true,
	skipDuplicateMapOutputs: true,
	partitionBy('hash', 1)) ~> upsertLead
Filter3 sink(allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	partitionFileNames:['contact_update_Contact_Notes.csv'],
	skipDuplicateMapInputs: true,
	skipDuplicateMapOutputs: true,
	partitionBy('hash', 1)) ~> notesContact
Filter4 sink(allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	partitionFileNames:['contact_update_Lead_Notes.csv'],
	skipDuplicateMapInputs: true,
	skipDuplicateMapOutputs: true,
	partitionBy('hash', 1)) ~> notesLead
Select9 sink(allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	partitionFileNames:['contact_update_caret_date_Contact.csv'],
	skipDuplicateMapInputs: true,
	skipDuplicateMapOutputs: true,
	partitionBy('hash', 1)) ~> caretDateContact
Select10 sink(allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
